integrity: Analytic proof, finite independent exact-volume checks, transparent bibliographic comparisons. No assertion of external scientific certification or exhaustive worldwide novelty.
scientific_limitations: Real finite metric spaces with one longer distance, parameter \(1\le t\le2\). The maximizer is within this family, not among all metrics. Rational finite-dimensional checks are supplementary, and equivalent unindexed prior results cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp long-edge Mahler maximizers in one-defect Lipschitz-free spaces
